findings.statement: spatio_flux reproduces the brownian_particles test-suite artifacts and the composite's structural schema matches its committed reference.

The agents' mean-squared displacement grows with a positive slope over the run (net diffusive spreading) and the population count is non-decreasing. Few-particle Brownian runs are noisy, so this is a spreading check, not a strict MSD-linearity claim (single runs vary in slope and fit quality).
